incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired — INC-2023-APAC (inference-high-5xx-rate)
incident-bot: Alert: inference-service (hosted-api) in ap-southeast-1 reporting elevated 5xx and latency spikes. Link: <https://pagerduty.example/INC-2023-APAC|INC-2023-APAC>

sophia: oncall here, taking this. joining bridge in 2m. :raised_hand:

pagerbot: PD ack recorded — sophia acknowledged the incident. Escalation timer set (10m).

leo: any initial customer reports? which routes affected?

sophia: quick summary: 90th pct latency jumped from 120ms -> 1.2s, 5xx rate ~8% over last 3m for /v1/generate. Errors look like upstream model timeouts + OOMs on a subset of pods.

amira: joining bridge now. forwarding bridge link: https://zoom.example/bridge/inf-2023

dave: CS: we already have 3 tickets from AcmeCorp and BetaApps showing timeouts. They're escalating. DMed the account lead.

leo: ok, priority is (1) customer mitigation, (2) stabilise fleets, (3) find root cause.

sophia: running quick pod status:```kubectl get pods -n inference --selector=app=inference-svc -o wide
# many pods in CrashLoopBackOff on ap-sg-1 nodes
```

sophia: logs snippet from a crashed worker:
```2023-10-22T14:36:41Z ERROR inference.worker kv-cache failed to allocate buffer: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
2023-10-22T14:36:42Z WARN inference.request request timed out after 30s
```

amira: autoscaler logs show a quota exception when trying to request new GPU instances from cloud provider in ap-southeast-1. looks like soft quota reached.

pagerbot: Note: autoscaler attempted 3 scale-up ops; cloud provider returned 403 QuotaExceeded.

sophia: mitigation plan: (A) temporarily route heavy tenants to fallback variant (smaller model) (B) scale up dedicated pool in eu-west as cross-region fallback for low-latency customers (C) roll back last config that changed batch sizing. Applying (C) now.

sophia: rollback command: ``kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-svc -n inference --to-revision=42``
sophia: rollback applied, starting canary traffic split at 14:39.

leo: can CS throttle non-prod tenants or throttle token rate for affected customers? we should reduce load quickly.

dave: CS: pushing a temporary token rate limit for BetaApps and non-critical tenants. AcmeCorp is a paid tenant, will be routed to eu fallback if they accept slightly higher latency.

sophia: enabling fallback variant for hosted route:```PATCH /config/routes/hosted
{"fallback_model":"gpt-small-v1","fallback_enabled":true}
```
sophia: fallback enabled, ~30% of traffic now on fallback. initial 5xx rate dropped to 1.8% on canary nodes.

amira: cloud quota request submitted to provider support; ETA 45-90m. meanwhile we're safe with cross-region routing for critical customers.

leo: please add to timeline and capture the deploy id that triggered the regression.

sophia: notes saved to incident doc and will capture deploy: deploy-2023-10-22-14:31 (batch-config-change).

incident-bot: bridge created by sophia — https://zoom.example/bridge/inf-2023

pagerbot: PD update: escalated to L2 (infra) at 14:45 per timeout rule.

leo: infra pinged. amira please keep working quota path with cloud team.

amira: on it. cloud support responded, asked for usage report. sending logs now.

sophia: status update 14:52: fallback holding, canary looks stable, customer tickets are being triaged by CS. 5xx rate down to ~0.7% org-wide. continuing to monitor for 30m.

dave: AcmeCorp support rep confirmed reduced errors after failover. they're ok with eu fallback for now. will update account lead.

leo: good. action items: (1) postmortem + timeline (sophia), (2) confirm cloud quota increase (amira), (3) add guardrail to prevent batch-size deploys without canary (product + eng).

sophia: logging all artifacts. will open postmortem draft and tag folks.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty: incident INC-2023-APAC marked resolved by sophia at 15:06. Summary: regression from batch-size config + cloud quota exhaustion caused OOMs and 5xxs; temporary mitigations included rollback, fallback model routing, cross-region routing, and token rate throttles for low-priority tenants.

sophia: thanks everyone — will ping when postmortem is ready. :coffee:
summary: PagerDuty page in ap-southeast-1: high 5xx rate; oncall acknowledged, rollback + fallback + cross-region routing mitigations; cloud quota + batch-size change root cause; incident resolved
